changelog:
- Initial release of the pptx skill for working with PowerPoint presentations.
- Supports creating, editing, and analyzing .pptx files, including reading content, editing, and creating from scratch.
- Provides design guidance with color palettes, layout ideas, and typography suggestions.
- Includes detailed QA instructions for both content and visual review to ensure presentation quality.
- Clear description of when to use the skill based on user prompts related to presentations.
summary: Create, edit, and analyze PowerPoint presentations. Invoke when user asks about PPT, slides, presentations, or needs to create/modify .pptx files.
